_comment_1: RECOMMENDED Realtime Database rules — NOT yet deployed. See the Security section of README.md.
_comment_2: The database is currently world-readable AND world-writable, so anyone can delete every node in it. These rules close that while keeping the site working.
_comment_3: Deploy with: firebase deploy --only database  (or paste into Console > Realtime Database > Rules).
_comment_4: Seed final_event/ BEFORE deploying these — they intentionally forbid the bulk writes that scripts/seed-final-event.mjs makes.

rules._comment_other_app: Owned by the other app, left exactly as open as it is today so nothing breaks. Tighten these once that app can authenticate.

items._comment: Public read; edit item text from the Firebase console only.

$entry._comment: Create-only: a submitted name can never be edited or deleted by a visitor, so the roster cannot be vandalised or wiped from the client.

isNpc._comment: Public submissions are never NPCs, so they can never be censored.
